title: Vetch
description: Vetch knew Cassian Andor on Ferrix. Both Vetch and Andor knew Nurchi, a scrap dealer. Andor owed Nurchi for parts, and Nurchi tried to stop him to collect his debt. When Nurchi indicated the presence of Vetch, Andor asked Vetch why he was there. Vetch admitted tthat Nurchi wanted him to stand there to intimidate Andor. Andor simply went on his way.
